frameSource: GitHub search is:pr is:merged merged:2026-01-01..2026-09-22; public gh GET. Require incomplete_results=false, total count consistency and all pages within 1000 search cap.
sampling: Census when <=12 canonical functional changes, otherwise first 12 eligible by SHA256 of mature-2026-10-23-v1|repo#number; titles/repair labels/outcomes do not select rows. Exclude metadata-only, harness, tests/docs-only and derived-only work by inspected file role; retain mixed functional work. Publish all exclusions and full frame IDs.
followup: Retrieve merged PR metadata and structured files through cutoff; inspect all later PRs that touch an index artifact or directly name its PR/commit. Same-file overlap is a candidate, never causal proof. Review introducing links and regression tests before confirming; preserve unknown attribution and unseen direct-commit/issue gaps.
claims: Project-history associations only; no inference from absent observed repair to bug-free code. No language-wide or AI-specific causal claim. Related AILANG repos share one cluster. Public PRs may miss direct pushes and manual merges; confirmation rate unavailable where ascertainment/linkage is unknown.
annotation: One attended coding-agent review; source-linked notes, explicit supported vs independently reproduced. No automatic fix-keyword labels. Record AI assistance disclosures separately. No independent agreement estimate.
instrument: sunholo/maintenance_bench@0.1.0 for native cohorts/lineage/reports. No semantics changes. Supplemental hand-reviewed later-touch endpoint is separate from the package's confirmed linked-repair measure.
changesFromPilot: Merged-time mature index frame, full follow-up search, deterministic eligibility sampling. Keep earlier pilot unchanged. Prior familiar case studies are exploratory and may overlap follow-up.
